label: Kauai Composite Squadron
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: Unit emblem of Kauai Composite Squadron (PCR-HI-073), digital artwork supplied by Ethan Hillard on 2026-11-11. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (VP8L lossless) -> png via dwebp; reduced in size from 1516 x 1736 to 1048 x 1200 px (area average, alpha premultiplied; the long edge is held to 1200 px as the other digital patches are); no redrawing, no tracing, no colour change. Charter: PCR-HI-073 is Kauai Composite Squadron in the builder's unit list; Hawaii Wing's heraldry page (https://hiwg.cap.gov/about/heraldry-of-our-units) shows the same emblem under Kauai Composite Squadron, PCR-HI-073, and the unit's own site (kauai.cap.gov) carries the same charter.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the size, held to 1200 px on the long edge.
